task.description:
Implement ISS-101: Allow FAILED in timers.status CHECK constraint.

Per the design artefact from CODE-DESIGNER:
1. Run codegen: python tools/codegen_migration.py templates/specs/iss101-timers-failed-status.migration.yaml
   - This produces migrations/NNN_timers_failed_status.sql
2. If migration not fully generated, write it manually:
   - ALTER the CHECK constraint on timers.status to include FAILED
   - Migration must be idempotent
   - Must apply to every existing tenant schema
3. In src/scheduler/scheduler.zig, verify/update the code path that sets timer status FAILED
   after exhausted retries -- ensure correct status string and error set.
4. Validate: zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate -- all must exit 0
5. Commit to feature/WF02-iss101-20260611
acceptance_criteria: Migration alters timers.status CHECK to include FAILED alongside PENDING, FIRED, CANCELLED
Migration applies to all tenant schemas
Setting timers.status=FAILED succeeds in integration test
Invalid status value still raises constraint violation
